Shri R. J. Shinde, Advocate for applicant.
Shri N. R. Rode, A. P. P. for respondent No.1.

Coram: Vinay Joshi And
 Bharat P. Deshpande, Jj.

1. Heard.
2.

This is an application seeking to quash Fir in Crime No.0146/2023 registered for the offence
punishable under Section 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code.
3.  It is applicant's contention that the allegations levelled in the FIR nowhere constitute the offence of rape.
It is pointed out that the victim is married lady aged about 26 years having two children.
According to the applicant, in view of her marital status, the story of obtaining her consent for sexual relations on the false pretext of marriage is improbable.
Thus, it is a case of consensual relationship.

4. Issue notice for final disposal to the respondents, returnable on 16/06/2023.
